name: 3D tour - media showcase
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3D tour - media showcase.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Viewer mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for viewer mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Auto-advance image rotation
settings.how: Turn on “Auto-advance image rotation” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.default: Inspect the space in 3D—with an interactive model and supporting images.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.
